$comment: SEED. Replace policies and widget mappings with values derived from your own generated chapters — see docs/visual-grammar.md section 5. The shape is the deliverable; the rows are a starting point.

policies.required: A segment of this type without a valid widget payload FAILS validation.
policies.expected: Diagram unless the planner records an explicit `visual_waiver` reason. Waivers are audited.
policies.optional: Planner's call. No waiver needed either way.
policies.prohibited: A diagram here is noise. Payload present = validation failure.

concept_types.label: Projectile launched from the ground at an angle
concept_types.note: Range/apex/time-of-flight, complementary angles.

concept_types.label: Horizontal launch from a height; independence of the two axes
concept_types.note: The bullet-fired-vs-bullet-dropped case. v1 CANNOT draw this — needs launch_mode + companion body.

concept_types.label: Projectile onto or along an inclined plane
concept_types.note: GAP. No widget yet.

concept_types.label: x-t, v-t, a-t graph reading and construction
concept_types.note: GAP. High frequency across mechanics; likely an early build.

concept_types.label: Lens or mirror ray construction, image formation
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Two-source interference, fringe pattern and intensity
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Force resolution on a body, free-body diagram
concept_types.note: GAP. Probably the single highest-frequency physics diagram.

concept_types.label: P-V diagram for a thermodynamic process or cycle
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Defining a quantity, its symbol, units and sign convention
concept_types.note: A diagram here competes with the definition for attention.

concept_types.label: Plugging values into an already-derived formula
concept_types.note: Draw only if the setup itself is geometric.

concept_types.label: Naming, drawing or comparing a molecular structure
concept_types.note: 3D only where conformation or stereochemistry is the point; a 2D skeletal widget is a separate gap.

concept_types.label: One step of a reaction mechanism, arrow pushing
concept_types.note: GAP. Highest-value chemistry widget; arrow pushing is not renderable as a static SVG the model writes.

concept_types.label: Chirality, R/S, conformers, optical isomerism
concept_types.note: The one place a flat diagram genuinely cannot teach the idea.

concept_types.label: pH against titrant volume, equivalence and buffer regions
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Le Chatelier response to a change in conditions
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: A trend across a period or down a group
concept_types.note: GAP. A small trend-plot widget covers most of inorganic.

concept_types.label: Named compounds, colours, uses, occurrence
concept_types.note: Largely list-shaped. Resists visualisation and that is fine.

concept_types.label: Loci, conics, lines and their intersections in the plane
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Monotonicity, extrema, concavity, area under a curve
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Angles, signs and identities on the unit circle
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Vectors, planes and lines in three dimensions
concept_types.note: GAP.

concept_types.label: Enumerating outcomes, tree diagrams, Venn relations
concept_types.note: GAP. Tree/Venn covers most of it.

concept_types.label: Symbolic derivation, identity proof, series expansion
concept_types.note: Nothing spatial. A decorative diagram here actively hurts.

concept_types.label: A solved problem
concept_types.note: Inherits the visual need of the underlying concept_type; the planner should name that type here too.

concept_types.label: DNA, RNA, protein, carbohydrate, lipid structure
concept_types.note: Macromolecules come from RCSB PDB, not generated.

concept_types.label: A labelled organ, organelle or tissue figure
concept_types.note: GAP. Likely the largest single gap in NEET biology; consider a curated illustrated-asset library rather than a generative widget.

concept_types.label: A cyclic or sequential process — Krebs, Calvin, cell cycle, nitrogen cycle
concept_types.note: GAP. One flow/cycle widget covers a large fraction of biology.

concept_types.label: Punnett squares, pedigree charts, dihybrid crosses
concept_types.note: GAP. Highly regular structure — cheap widget, high coverage.

concept_types.label: Taxonomy, named examples, characteristic lists
